weakness: No MFA on the online store administrator account or on the email account that can reset it
remediation_plan: Turn on MFA for both; unique passphrases in a password manager; recovery codes into the sealed envelope
milestones: 2026-09-15 MFA on and tested for both accounts
resources_required: Owner time (1 hour); password manager about $40 a year

weakness: Default, reused, posted, and shared passwords (router, terminal manager password, Wi-Fi, online store, POS PIN)
source: P07 assessment (IA-05 objectives, including the new terminal default password finding); P03 G-007 (2.2), G-033 (8.2), G-034 (8.3)
remediation_plan: Terminal manager password changed 2026-08-13; change router and Wi-Fi passwords and stop posting the Wi-Fi password; separate cashier-level POS user; written lost-phone and compromised-password steps
milestones: 2026-08-13 terminal password changed (done); 2026-09-30 router, Wi-Fi, and POS changes complete

weakness: Customers' phones share the terminal's network; nothing watches the network
remediation_plan: Turn on the guest network for customers; put the terminal on its own network or VLAN with the outside IT helper; quarterly look at connected devices
milestones: 2026-09-30 guest network on and retested; 2026-12-31 terminal network separated and retested
resources_required: Router with VLAN support or a second small router (about $120); outside IT helper (2 hours)

weakness: Paper card data with security codes kept in an unlocked drawer until destroyed
remediation_plan: Card data never written down (started 2026-08-11); locked drawer for any paper with customer details; weekly pad check until 2026-09-30
milestones: 2026-08-11 practice stopped and 23 pages shredded (done); 2026-09-15 locked drawer in place; 2026-09-30 weekly checks complete

weakness: Paper with customer details thrown in the regular trash; no device trade-in record
remediation_plan: Cross-cut shredder at the counter; device wipe steps and a disposal record (POL-01 8.6)
milestones: 2026-09-15 shredder in use; 2026-09-30 disposal record started

weakness: No inventory with the terminal's identity, add-ons, or review cycle
source: P07 assessment (CM-08 objectives); P03 G-042 (9.5), G-060 (12.5)
remediation_plan: Add serial number, location, and provider fields to the system list; review it each August with the scope note; daily terminal inspection (POL-01 7.8)
milestones: 2026-09-30 inventory updated and inspection checklist in use

weakness: No provider list or annual check; POS app vendor assurance unknown; customer data in a consumer AI chatbot
source: P07 assessment (SA-09 objectives); P03 G-063 (12.8); P10
remediation_plan: Provider list with PCI DSS responsibilities; annual AOC and SOC 2 check each August; ask the POS app vendor for its security documentation; AI chatbot rules (P10)
milestones: 2026-08-24 customer data stopped going to the chatbot (done); 2026-10-31 provider list complete

weakness: Online store, email, and refunds activity never reviewed
remediation_plan: Monthly check on the first Monday using a one-page checklist; weekly for 3 months after any incident or processor alert
milestones: 2026-10-05 first monthly check; 2026-10-31 checklist in use
